::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** November [1850]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. This fragment printed in Romanes, <i>[Appreciation](other_books/otherbook_241.qmd)</i> 54
:::

You really must beg, borrow or steal something to help me.[^1]  After this winter I shall get on better, but there are *[The Two Guardians](cmy_books/cmybook_13.qmd)* and the *[Landmarks of History](cmy_books/cmybook_14.qmd)* to finish before I can feel really at ease in giving my mind to this affair.  I am rather afraid of spoiling the *Landmarks*  by getting into a hurry.  If you can send me something, I think we could meet the first of January, but I am sure I cannot single-handed. . . .I wish it had found a name;  if there was any word to express 'for Confirmation girls' it would be the thing.  . . .

---

[^1]: i.e. to provide material for the new magazine, the first issue of which appeared on 1 January 1851 under the title *[The Monthly  Packet of Evening Readings for Younger Members of the English Church](organizations/other_52.qmd)*.
